_readme: Predefined curriculum source URLs for the bow-rollout cloud routine, so it fetches known-good official DepEd MATATAG Curriculum Guide PDFs directly instead of running open-ended WebSearch every run (saves tokens). Compiled 2026-08-14 from deped.gov.ph. 'confidence: high' entries are official DepEd CG PDFs that explicitly cover the target grade's key stage — WebFetch these directly. 'confidence: partial' entries are the best official document found but may not clearly break out that specific grade (e.g. it's a K-3 or multi-grade combined guide) — WebFetch first, and only fall back to one targeted WebSearch if the fetched content doesn't actually cover the target grade's competencies. 'confidence: none' means no official document was found — go straight to WebSearch/WebFetch research for that one, same as before this manifest existed. Grades 4 and 6 intentionally share the same source docs: DepEd's Key Stage 2 (Grades 4-6) curriculum guides are published as one document per subject spanning all three grades, titled by the launch-year grades (e.g. 'Grade 4 and 7') rather than split per grade — look for the Grade 6-specific competency table inside the same PDF, don't search for a separate Grade-6-only file.

English.note: K-3 Reading and Literacy CG covers the English literacy strand; confirm it breaks out Grade 3 specifically.

Mathematics.note: Full Grades 1-10 Math CG mirror (also at eduksama.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/FINAL-MATATAG-Mathematics-CG-2023-Grades-1-10.pdf); has complete quarter-by-quarter Grade 3 competency tables.

Filipino.note: The Reading-and-Literacy PDF is actually Grade-1-only content despite its 'K-3' framing in the intro pages (real Grade 2/3 competencies live in the Filipino/English CGs instead) — still useful for the KS1 subdomain framework and spiral-progression logic. Second URL is Grade 4/7 Filipino, structure reference only. A full 'FINAL-MATATAG-English-CG-2023-Grades-2-10-withAppendices.pdf' exists at eduksama.com — worth fetching directly for Grade 3 English/Filipino next run instead of using the Reading-and-Literacy doc.

Science.note: Full Grades 3-10 Science CG; Science begins as its own subject in Grade 3 under MATATAG, and this doc has complete quarter-by-quarter Grade 3 tables (Q1 Materials, Q2 Living Things, Q3 Force/Motion/Energy, Q4 Earth and Space).

GMRC.note: Confirmed fetchable (104pp). Contains full Baitang 1 and Baitang 4 markahan tables plus Key Stage/Grade Level standards, but does NOT contain a full Baitang 3 competency table with the same a/b/c Kasanayang Pampagkatuto detail as Baitang 1/4 — Baitang 3 content in the authored migration was constructed from the Grade Level standard paragraph and the vertical-articulation example (PWD topic under 'Magalang') rather than lifted verbatim from a Baitang 3 table.

Makabansa.note: Full official Makabansa Grades 1-3 CG with complete Baitang 3 (Grade 3) competencies across all 4 markahan, plus MAPEH-integration suggested activities.

Computer.note: No official MATATAG document — this app's own addition, not a DepEd-mandated subject at this grade band. Write age-appropriate basic computer/ICT literacy competencies from general best practice, consistent with what Grade 2's existing budget_of_work row does.

English.note: Confirmed fetchable; full Grade 4 EN4LR/EN4SW/EN4VR quarter tables used verbatim (Q1 mealtimes/birthdays, Q2 christenings/weddings, Q3 funerals/symposia, Q4 national holidays).

Mathematics.note: Grade 4 Q1-Q4 competency tables used (whole numbers to 1,000,000; fractions; angles/quadrilaterals; decimals/single line graphs).

Filipino.note: Confirmed fetchable; full Baitang 4 markahan tables used verbatim (alamat/pabula, anekdota/talaarawan, mito/epiko/talambuhay, panuto/proseso).

Science.note: Grade 4 Q1-Q4 competency tables used (materials/mixtures, living things/systems, force-motion-energy/magnets-circuits, earth-and-space/soil-weather-sun).

Araling Panlipunan.note: Confirmed fetchable; full Baitang 4 'Ang Bansang Pilipinas' markahan tables used verbatim (Heograpiya, Ekonomiya, Pamahalaan, Pagkakakilanlan).

EPP (ICT).note: URL not actually fetched this pass (time-boxed); Grade 4 EPP(ICT) content in the authored migration was reasonably constructed from general MATATAG EPP exploratory-strand structure and Grade 3 Computer as a predecessor, not lifted from this doc. Worth fetching directly next time to verify/replace.

EPP (AFA/FCS/IA).note: Same as EPP (ICT) above — content constructed, not lifted from this doc. Worth fetching directly next time to verify/replace.

MAPEH.note: This only covers the PE & Health half of MAPEH; Music & Arts CG still not found. The authored Grade 4 MAPEH migration was reasonably constructed (general MATATAG MAPEH quarter-rotation structure), not lifted from an official Music/Arts source — one WebSearch for 'MATATAG Music and Arts CG Grade 4' is still needed to upgrade this.

GMRC.note: Authored using the full Baitang 4 table (4 markahan, each with Nilalaman/Pamantayang Pangnilalaman/Kasanayang Pampagkatuto a-b-c/Pamantayan sa Pagganap/Lilinanging Pagpapahalaga) captured earlier this session; content reconstructed from that structure rather than re-quoting the PDF verbatim.

English.note: Not fetched this pass — the Grade 4 doc's filename suggests it covers Grade 4 and Grade 7 (Key Stage 3), not Grade 6 specifically. Grade 6 content was constructed by extending the Grade 4 LR/SW/VR pattern and general Key Stage 2 spiral progression, not lifted from a fetched source. Worth a targeted fetch/search next time to verify or find the actual Grade 5-6 document.

Mathematics.note: Not fetched this pass; content constructed from standard DepEd Grade 6 math scope (ratio/percent/integers, space figures, algebra intro, statistics/probability). Verify against source next time.

Filipino.note: Not fetched this pass; content constructed by extending the Baitang 4 markahan pattern toward more advanced text types (epiko, panayam, sanaysay/editoryal, talumpati). Verify against source next time.

Araling Panlipunan.note: Not fetched this pass; content constructed by extending the expanding-environment model to 'Ang Daigdig' (world), following the known Grade 4=Pilipinas / Grade 5=Asya / Grade 6=Daigdig progression. Verify against source next time.

EPP (ICT).note: Not fetched; content constructed as an advanced extension of the Grade 4 EPP(ICT) migration.

Content constructed as an advanced extension of the Baitang 4 GMRC pattern (Pagpapahalaga sa sarili -> Matapat -> Mapagmalasakit -> Pagmamahal sa Bayan progression extended toward Mapanagutan/Tiwala sa sarili/Nasyonalismo). Verify against an actual Grade 5-6 GMRC source next time.
